mechanismHypothesisNotImplementation.candidate: Bounded direct anchor-to-current region correspondence, decoupled from a requirement that one ID/cohort survives every adjacent exposure
mechanismHypothesisNotImplementation.contrast: Current M3K chains finite cohorts through adjacent updates and permanently discards them on missed reidentification/pixel support; direct current-vs-anchor measurement would establish new evidence instead of coasting an old alert
mechanismHypothesisNotImplementation.hardFloors: Fresh current pixels, unambiguous object relation, camera veto, independent direct-pair support and expansion, finite anchors, silence when unsupported; no metric output
mechanismHypothesisNotImplementation.unproven: Receipt-only candidates do not establish that direct anchors recover a miss or preserve false-positive rate. Need actual bounded A/B replay and untouched clips; do not lower growth thresholds or use GT at inference

limits: Source-projected boxes are evaluation diagnostics, not reviewed per-frame truth. Unlabelled adjacent exposures are unknown. Internal-ID changes are not certified MOT switches.
